title: Young Women from Tabriz Take Up Arms on the Shores of the Persian Gulf
text:
Young Women from Tabriz Take Up Arms on the Shores of the Persian Gulf"

""
"Young women participating in the popular caravan titled "Devotees of Iran; from Azerbaijan to the Persian Gulf" gathered on the coast of the Persian Gulf. Brandishing weapons, they displayed their strength, readiness, and resolve, while underscoring a message of national unity, the defense of Iran's territorial integrity, and a firm commitment to safeguarding the waterway."

"Their presence marked the culmination of a journey of over 2,000 kilometers (1,240 miles) from the northwestern Iranian province of Azerbaijan to the southern coastline. The caravan carried a clear and emphatic message: "We stand ready to give our lives for Iran, and the Persian Gulf will forever remain Persian.
